status: Secondary sensitivity diagnostic fixed before new evaluation outcomes
excluded_region: Native voxels within the superior 9 mm endcap, including the last plane
purpose: The final coarse common-grid plane can lie beyond the original CT extent. Decimation extends its last retained plane; native preprocessing uses constant air outside the acquired domain. Check whether full-volume augmentation/context effects are concentrated at this endpoint.
interpretation_limit: Restricted-volume Dice is a sensitivity analysis, not a replacement for full-volume scores or proof that all boundary handling effects are absent.
